content.comment_body: I'm also unable to connect to the [product_name]. Please see the attached file for further details. The issue is that I can't select my laptop's ethernet port, and only a unique WiFi option appears. Appreciate any assistance.
Does your laptop also have a LAN connection available? If so, the issue may be related to the installation of [product_name] software.
I did have a LAN connection. After reinstalling the drivers for the ethernet port, the issue was resolved. Thank you for the support.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced a problem where the software only detected the laptop's WiFi connection and did not allow selection of the ethernet port, leading to difficulties connecting to the [product_name] device. Reinstalling the ethernet port drivers resolved the issue, showing that proper driver installation is critical for network port recognition by the software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the application to detect and allow selection of all available network ports, including ethernet, to facilitate stable and reliable device connections.
